spans.s: Aśoka^1, a king: I, 67 (§ 130), 2650 (Aṃśāvat.) (an incarnation of the Asura Aśva); XII, 4, 114 (Rājadh.) (present at the self-choice of king Citrāṅgada's daughter in Śrīmadrājapura, where Duryodhana carries off the bride).
Aśokatīrtha, a tīrtha or holy place in the south: III, 88, 8338 (Dhaumyatīrthak.) (bahulāśramaṃ).
